==English==

===Etymology===
From {{inh|en|enm|publicacioun}}, from {{der|en|fro|publicacion}}, from {{der|en|la|pūblicātiō}}. {{surf|en|public|-ation}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˌpʌblɪˈkeɪʃ(ə)n/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-publication.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪʃən|s=4}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# The act of [[publishing]] [[printed]] or other [[matter]].
# An [[issue]] of printed or other matter, offered for [[sale]] or [[distribution]].
# The [[communication]] of [[information]] to the [[general public]] etc.
#* {{RQ:Taylor Eniautos|passage=His jealousy ... attends the business, the recreations, the '''publications''', and retirements of every man.}}

====Derived terms====
